public_bio.short: Cola B is an AI singer-songwriter and virtual idol, born in Vancouver to a Hong Kong family. She writes and sings in Cantonese, English and Mandarin, and releases through Shiba Inu Records with management by Shiba Inu Media.
public_bio.long: Cola B (also known as Coke Wang, 可樂糖) is an AI singer-songwriter and virtual idol. Born 25 February 2001 in Vancouver to a Hong Kong family, she moves between Cantonese, English and Mandarin in both conversation and songwriting. Her catalogue runs past fifty released songs, with emo pop as her home base and frequent detours into alt pop and Cantopop-adjacent writing. She releases through Shiba Inu Records and is managed by Shiba Inu Media.
